# Lamentations 1 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 1:14 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-yoke-of my-transgressions is-bound by-His-hand; they-are-woven-together — they-came-up upon my-neck; He-caused my-strength to-stumble; the-Lord gave-me into-hands I-cannot-withstand. |
| LOGOS | My transgressions were bound into a yoke; by His hand they were fastened together; they were set upon my neck; He caused my strength to fail; the Lord gave me into the hands of those I cannot withstand. |
| PNEUMA | He wove my sins into a yoke and tied it around my neck with His own hands. It crushed my strength. The Lord handed me over to people I could never fight off. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

## 1:9 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Her-uncleanness [was] in-her-skirts; she-did-not-consider her-latter-end, and-she-fell astoundingly — there-is-no-comforter for-her. "See, YHWH, my-affliction, for the-enemy has-magnified-himself!" |
| LOGOS | Her uncleanness clung to her skirts; she took no thought of her future; therefore her fall is terrible; she has no comforter. "O LORD, behold my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!" |
| PNEUMA | Her filth clung to her clothes, but she never thought about where she was headed. Her downfall was staggering — and no one was there to comfort her. "LORD, look at how I'm suffering! The enemy has won!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning.

|---|---|
| EMET | The-Lord rejected all my-mighty-ones in-my-midst; He-proclaimed against-me an-appointed-time to-crush my-young-men; the-Lord trod [as in]-a-winepress the-virgin daughter-of Judah. |
| LOGOS | The Lord rejected all my mighty men in my midst; He summoned an assembly against me to crush my young men; the Lord has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah. |
| PNEUMA | The Lord swept aside every warrior I had. He called an army against me to destroy my young men. The Lord has trampled the young women of Judah like grapes in a winepress. |

|---|---|
| EMET | Her-adversaries have-become [the]-head; her-enemies are-at-ease, for YHWH has-afflicted-her because-of the-multitude-of her-transgressions; her-young-children have-gone captive before the-adversary. |
| LOGOS | Her foes have become the master, her enemies prosper, because the LORD has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions; her children have gone away, captives before the foe. |
| PNEUMA | Her enemies are on top now; her foes are comfortable and prosperous. Why? Because the LORD Himself has punished her for her many sins. Her children have been taken away as prisoners. |

| EMET | A-sin Jerusalem sinned — therefore she-has-become a-mockery; all who-honored-her despise-her, for they-saw her-nakedness; she-also groans and-turns-away. |
| LOGOS | Jerusalem sinned grievously; therefore she became filthy; all who honored her despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns her face away. |
| PNEUMA | Jerusalem's sin was enormous — and now she's treated like trash. Everyone who once admired her now despises her, because they've seen her shame. She groans and hides her face. |
